create_chunk_multimodal: create a Chunk with multimodal content including strings, bytes, and PIL images with inferred content types
build_chunklist_concatenate: build a ChunkList by concatenating multiple Chunks and ContentType values using addition operators
test_chunk_content_validation: test Chunk content type validation to ensure Python types match declared content_type prefixes
refactor_chunklist_strip: refactor ChunkList strip methods to remove leading and trailing empty chunks while applying lstrip/rstrip to non-empty content
summarize_message_normalization: summarize Message.create_normalized to convert string and ChunkList content into a consistent normalized representation
